src: RWY 15L of 1985 (old C runway): NW edge of the threshold stripes on the centreline traced on GSI gazo3 z17 1984-86 photos; roll start R11 DFDR via track.md 2. REF POINT: the aircraft reference point stands here at 18:11:32 (the position D4 writes = the b744 model origin: mid-length about 35 m aft of the nose tip and near the main gear); the lift-off row is for the same point; where the crew lined up is not recorded: tol

15L centreline 1540 m from the threshold row (true 145.39) for the same reference point. DISTANCE: D1 dfdr_1hz (R11 DFDR fig.1 with its scan lean corrected) as GS = CAS x 1.024 - 5.4 kt (29 C and QNH 29.93; wind 216/16 between the Haneda 18:00 and 18:30 obs of EN p.19) integrated 18:11:48-18:12:12 = 1304 m (1284-1321 m for wind 210/15 to 220/17 and TAS/CAS +-0.5 %); plus 173-298 m for 18:11:32-18:11:48 while CAS sits on or near its 50 kt floor (from a late standstill at full thrust to a rolling start; middle 236 m): 1304 + 236 = 1540 m; range 1284 + 173 = 1457 to 1321 + 298 = 1620 m (inputs/liftoff.py). TIME: R10 p.290 lists lift-off at 18:12:16 from DFDR fig.1: the first second the ALT trace leaves its runway reading (-11 to +46 ft). The table's clock agrees with R10's DFDR times within about 1 s (D4: README 3.1) so this is not a clock offset: the ALT trace resolves about 100 ft and first steps up about 4 s after the wheels leave. R11 fig.2 pitch 9.8 at 18:12:12 after 2.5 deg/s from 18:12:08 and easing after it; VRTG rises clear of 1 (0.97 then 1.06 and on to 1.17); first roll (1.4 R); the heading steps 151.4 -> 155.5 mag from 18:12:12 as the aircraft takes up a crab into the 15 kt crosswind from the right. Pitch is 16.6 at 18:12:16 and a 747 on its wheels would strike its tail

track.md 2 (R05 fig.13 geometry and GSI DEM 1534 m); larch on ground at about 1530 m cut about 14 m up (EN p.8 and p.12 2.4.3.7): alt = 1544 m = the cut. PART: engine fan exit case and cascade vane parts in the cut (EN p.11 2.4.2.5(3)); the report does not name the engine: No.4 (right outboard) by the right bank and the No.4 debris from the larch to the U-ditch (EN p.12 2.4.3.6 and 2.4.3.8). At DFDR bank 46 R it hangs about 15-18 m below the fuselage centreline: offset by attitude

track.md 2 (R05 fig.13 geometry and GSI DEM 1606 m); U-shaped ditch on the ridge at 1610 m about 520 m WNW of the larch (EN p.8). PART: right wing tip (tip parts and wing skin in the ditch: EN p.12 2.4.3.5). The bank at the contact is not recorded: dfdr_1hz's last roll is 59.5 R at 18:56:24 and its rows are empty from 18:56:25 (R10 p.294: abnormal data from about 18:56:26); at 60-80 R the tip (half-span 29.8 m) hangs about 25-29 m below the fuselage centreline: offset by attitude
